text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.232 for the AI Software Developer position. Their strongest evidence is a computer science degree and over five years of relevant experience, alongside some familiarity with "Node.js" and "Docker". Key gaps include the absence of required machine learning, C#, and SQL expertise, as well as several nice-to-have skills. This application has been escalated for manual review despite the missing must-have requirements and low overall fit.
